notes: ActiveCam write at second occurrence of this pattern (IGCS reference). occurrence=2 set in intercept. Uses quaternion rotation (0xF0) + coords at +0xE0. Camera base register is rbx.

intercepts.name: activecam_write1
intercepts.description: ActiveCam coord+quaternion write. literal=1.0.11, wildcard tries 2.x (same opcodes, wildcarded offsets). occurrence=2 per IGCS.

camera_write_profile._comment: Quaternion rotation derived from pose pitch/yaw/roll via _euler_deg_to_quat (standard XYZ intrinsic). If in-game rotation is mirrored or off-axis, try negating yaw or swapping yaw/roll in the conversion. fov=0x128 is freecam FOV; switch to 0x37C for gameplay cam.
